study: Full fixed-configuration evaluation on the existing filtered Ordinary 3EED Validation roster

roster.unit: One record per original target description and annotation slot, retaining multiple descriptions from the same frame when present. No replication by source checkpoint.
roster.scope: Previously exposed R183/R96 Ordinary Validation view. Preserve the existing filter, original order and R97point per-expression sampling. Source rows are sealed in 3eed_v2_ordinary_val_subject_ranking_20261119. Raw referring text is read by its existing slot exactly as in the first Qwen study. No new cohort selection.

inference.mode: Frozen BF16 greedy, SDPA, complete RGB frame, original separate 2D and 3D prompts and unchanged parser
inference.schedule: Batch images by original platform (constant vision shape) and output task for throughput. Check computational batching against a frozen subset of prior model replies before generation. Reuse sealed outputs only after exact RGB, expression, task, checkpoint, prompt-code and generation-setting matching.

arms.A: Original Qwen with existing image-ray/window median depth correction and fallbacks
arms.H: C_E_Qsize, original full-region four-scale box completion
arms.L7: Historical L7 single largest radius level (index 7), original region attribution and same completion rules
arms.C_pca: Historical C_pca, fixed Qwen dimensions on the fitting-side support with PCA-centred camera-facing anchoring
arms.C_ray: Historical C_ray, same fitting-side node and dimensions, choose the PCA or Qwen yaw's separately anchored box using the previously locked independent selection rays

configuration: Main method H. Pin prior geometry and model files. Use uploaded historical source with identical small-panel outputs as the implementation reference. Read access to the old Ordinary manifests and frozen replies only for predictions. Seal all predictions before new task GT is opened.

analysis.main: Strict upright oriented IoU >0.50. Also report Acc@25, mIoU, platform macro and pooled description mean.
analysis.strata: By platform and recording, report all rescues/harms and IoU changes. Also score all fallback rows and descriptive distributions by annotated category, GT radial distance and number of annotated objects after sealing.
analysis.bootstrap: 4000 paired draws of recordings within platform (seed 20261121). Publish all strata and every anonymized per-description outcome.
analysis.interpretation: Existing ordinary full-roster evaluation, already exposed to previous project development. Main method fixed by the user. Independent new-recording generalization remains pending.
